x: Graeme Hyett, road running, cross country and steeplechase

Simon Jones and James Kelly took a double victory in the A and B 5000 to produce maximum points and new member Graeme Hyett brought respectability to the ’chase, finishing close to his best in a good class field; but no B runner meant more squandered points.
Last man into the A team after Jonathan Blackledge’s injury was Graeme Hyett. This man tells us that the longer and harder and muddier it is, the more he likes it.
And in the ‘B’ team, Paul Freary had run 19:09 on three followed by Graeme Hyett just a second slower on four and then Shaun Moralee exactly matching Graeme’s time on five.
